ops.text: a. Performance Warranties. TrueLink further represents and warrants that (i) the Services, including the Hosting Services and Support Services, will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner; (ii) for a period of 90 days following performance of the Services, the Services and any deliverables will conform to their documentation; (iii) for a period of 12 months following delivery, the Interface and all related software will conform to its documentation; (iv) it will comply with all laws applicable to its performance under this Agreement; and (v) the Interface and all related software will, at the time provided to Client, be free from viruses, worms, Trojan horses and any other malicious code. Client's remedy for breach of this Section is, at TrueLink's option, repair, replacement, or a refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, deliverables, Interface or software.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only a Y2K warranty, so we add TrueLink's performance warranties: the Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, a 90-day conformance period for the Services and deliverables measured from performance, 12-month software conformance to documentation, compliance with laws and no malicious code, with a repair, replacement or refund remedy. This is our preferred warranty position.
